title: Apartment Interior Design 63 m² in Kraków | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 63 m² apartment in Kraków: design project, 3D visualization, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Apartment interior design, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 63 m²

blocks.text: Apartment interior design, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 63 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed a comprehensive project for a 63 m² apartment, including the interior design and technical documentation, custom furniture solutions, a turnkey renovation, and final decorating.

The layout and interior solutions were developed for the apartment’s main functional areas: the living room, bedroom, kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom. Particular attention was paid to ergonomics, efficient use of floor area, and well-organized, convenient storage systems.

Custom furniture was designed for the interior, tailored to the dimensions and features of the rooms. Built-in wardrobes, storage systems, and furniture structures help use the apartment’s space efficiently and support a unified interior style.

The project was delivered end to end — from developing the concept and technical documentation to the renovation work, the manufacture and installation of the furniture, and interior decorating. Before implementation began, a detailed cost estimate was prepared covering renovation work, finishing materials, furniture, and appliances.
The interior is presented through photorealistic 3D visualizations and a 3D tour that offer a detailed look at the layout, interior, and furniture solutions for this 63 m² apartment.
